text_block_list.text: The day of the Spring Stakes...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As a prelude to an even bigger event,
this race
would normally be something
to get excited over,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What? Five participants?! That's just
barely
enough to make a race!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Every year, this race has ten or more
runners in it!
What's going on?!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Before today, if you had told me there
would only
be five people in this race, I
would've thought
you were crazy...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Ah... Haha... There's really only five of
us...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
The reason so many Umamusume are
avoiding
this one could likely be
because she's here...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Let's just focus on performing at your best.

text_block_list.text:
It's still a race, so we should enjoy it!
Time to
focus!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
